name: Clicks Group Limited
source: Clicks Group Limited reviewed condensed consolidated annual group results for the year ended 31 August 2026, consolidated statement of comprehensive income (JSE SENS, 22 October 2026, senspdf.jse.co.za/documents/2026/jse/isse/CLS/H22026.pdf), figures R'000 scaled to ZAR. Revenue is group turnover 50,414,003; cost of sales is cost of merchandise sold 38,712,883; gross profit 11,701,120 is printed. Operating expenses is DERIVED: total expenses 10,716,652 plus the 5,937 loss on disposal of property, plant and equipment less other income 3,913,599, which nets to 6,808,990 and reproduces the printed profit before financing costs of 4,892,130 when deducted from gross profit. Operating profit is the printed profit before financing costs. Net finance costs is the printed net financing expense 368,049; share of associates of 25 sits between it and profit before taxation, so profit before tax 4,524,106 is printed and ties: 4,892,130 - 368,049 + 25. Income tax 1,203,476 and profit for the year 3,320,630 are printed. EPS is printed basic earnings per share of 1,419.8 cents. ROE and ROA use the printed closing total equity 6,805,608 and total assets 24,125,952, the same basis as the older columns.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2021; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
